summary: EZGO Technologies filed a Form 6-K reporting that its board approved a 1-for-3 reverse share split, effective for Nasdaq trading on November 5, 2026, with shares reduced from 5,305,950 to approximately 1,768,650 and a new CUSIP G5279F128 under the unchanged symbol EZGO. Fractional shares are rounded up to one whole share; no shareholder vote was required under British Virgin Islands law, and VStock Transfer acts as exchange agent. The split is intended to lift the market price to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance. Watch for bid-price recovery and continued listing risk.
